name: 88 Acres
old_description: Soft-baked, perfectly chewy, and packed with the good stuff—like whole seeds, oats, and just the right amount of sweetness.
about:
Based in Canton, Massachusetts, 88 Acres operates a bakery producing seed-based nutrition bars, butters, and granola. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The product line centers on seeds—pumpkin, sunflower, and others—combined with gluten-free oats and simple ingredients. Manufacturing processes include soft-baking bars, roasting seeds, blending seed butters, and clustering granola. The facility is described as free from the top nine food allergens, and the company follows a Purity Protocol for gluten-free oats. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

88 Acres sells directly to consumers through its website and through retail partners, with a store locator on its site. Its customer base includes individual consumers seeking allergen-friendly snacks and retail outlets carrying the brand. No industrial or food-service customers are identified in the source material.

The brand emphasizes seed-based nutrition, simple ingredient lists, and freedom from common allergens as its core differentiators. It positions its products as alternatives to nut-based butters and conventional granola bars, highlighting plant-based protein from pumpkin seeds and the absence of chalky aftertastes in its protein bars.
built_on: 12g plant-based protein per bar from pumpkin seeds
